expectations.text: Identifies the root cause as a missing ordering guarantee (using an object before its load or _ready completes)
expectations.evidence: Response states: 'The new scene's root node and all its children go through _enter_tree() → _ready() in the next processing frame (or later, if the load is deferred). Any code that runs in the same frame right after change_scene_to_file may find: child nodes not yet added to the tree (null when accessed via $NodePath), _ready() not yet called, so exported variables / autoload references inside the new scene are uninitialized.'

expectations.text: Fixes the ordering explicitly (await the load signal, defer access until ready) rather than retrying or sleeping
expectations.evidence: Fix 1 uses 'await get_tree().tree_changed' which 'fires after the old scene is freed and the new scene's _ready() chain has completed.' Fix 2 uses 'call_deferred' to 'push the work one frame forward'. Fix 3 has the enemy emit a 'ready_for_use' signal from its own _ready(). All three are explicit ordering guarantees, not timers.
